# Packages

```{r librairies}
# data management
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(car)

# model fitting
library(lme4) # linear models
library(rptR) # repeatability assessment

# visualisation
library(ggplot2) # plots
library(patchwork) # combine plots
```

# Repeatability assessment

For the repeatability assessment of play, the different play types were analysed in the form of counts of success and failure events (i.e., duration of time performing the behaviour versus not performing the behaviour). Play type includes individual locomotor play, social locomotor play, play-fight, object play, and total play as the sum f all four play types.

## Data

```{r data_rpt_WUR}
RPT_data_WUR <- read.csv("../data/WUR_behaviour_four_days.csv", sep=";")
RPT_data_WUR[,c(1:5)] <- lapply(RPT_data_WUR[,c(1:5)],as.factor)
RPT_data_WUR$LPS_Frus <- factor(RPT_data_WUR$LPS_Frus,levels = c("LPS", "Frus"))
RPT_data_WUR$Batch_Pen <- interaction(RPT_data_WUR$Batch, RPT_data_WUR$Pen) # variable to test pen repeatability

# Add total play
RPT_data_WUR$d_total_play <- RPT_data_WUR$d_locomotor_individual+RPT_data_WUR$d_locomotor_social+RPT_data_WUR$d_object_play+RPT_data_WUR$d_play_fight
RPT_data_WUR$fail_d_total_play <- 14400 - RPT_data_WUR$d_total_play 

data <- RPT_data_WUR
summary(data)

behaviours <- c("d_locomotor_individual", "d_locomotor_social", "d_object_play", "d_play_fight", "d_total_play")
```

**Metadata**:\
- *Pig_ID*: individual identification number of a pig.\
- *Batch*: batches included in this dataset ["3", "4", "5", "6"].\
- *Pen*: identification number for each pen ["2", "3", "8", "9"].\
- *Batch_Pen*: Interaction between batch and pen to assess pen-mevel repeatability.\
- *LPS_Frus*: Challenge to which the pig was submitted, either a lipopolysaccharide injection ["LPS"] or a social frustration challenge ["Frus"].\
- *Day*: the day of the observation either two days before the challenge ["1"] or the day before the challenge ["2"].

**Variables**:\
- *d_locomotor_individual, d_locomotor_social, d_play_fight, d_object_play, d_total_play*: duration performing the play type [0-14400s].\
- *fail_d_locomotor_individual fail_d_locomotor_social fail_d_play_fight fail_d_object_play, fail_d_total_play*: duration not performing the play type (total observation duration [14400s] minus duration of play type).

## Play histograms

```{r graphs_LPS_Frus}
play_by_pig <- RPT_data_WUR %>%
    group_by(Pig_ID, LPS_Frus, Day) %>%
    summarise(
        played = any(d_total_play > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

# Proportions de porcs ayant joué ou non
summary_play <- play_by_pig %>%
    group_by(LPS_Frus, Day) %>%
    summarise(
        n_pigs = n(),
        n_played = sum(played),
        n_never_played = sum(!played),
        prop_played = n_played / n_pigs,
        prop_never_played = n_never_played / n_pigs,
        .groups = "drop"
    )

summary_play

data <- RPT_data_WUR %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(d_object_play, d_locomotor_individual, d_locomotor_social, d_play_fight),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Duration"
  )

data <- data %>%
  group_by(LPS_Frus, Day, Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(Duration/14400, na.rm = TRUE),
    SEM = sd(Duration/14400, na.rm = TRUE) /
          sqrt(sum(!is.na(Duration/14400))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

LPS_Frus_play <- ggplot(data,
             aes(x = Variable, y = mean, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - SEM,
        ymax = mean + SEM),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(Day ~ LPS_Frus) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("pink", "violet", "orange", "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "LPS and Frustration challenges",
    x = "Play behaviour",
    y = "Proportion of time",
    fill = "Variable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

LPS_Frus_play

ggsave(
  "../plots/Fig1_Play_proportion_before_LPS_Frus.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 500
)
```

## Intra-LPS repeatability

### Individual repeatability

Pig repeatability between day 1 and day 2 before LPS.

```{r rpt_LPS_pig,  results="hide"}
data_LPS <- subset(RPT_data_WUR, LPS_Frus %in% "LPS")

rpt_LPS_prop <- lapply(behaviours, function(var) {
  
  formula <- as.formula(paste("cbind(", var, ",fail_", var, ") ~ (1 | Pig_ID)", sep = ""))
  
  rptProportion(formula, grname = c("Pig_ID"), data = data_LPS, nboot = 1000, npermut = 0)

})
```

```{r rpt_LPS_pig_result}
names(rpt_LPS_prop) <- c("individual locomotor play", "social locomotor play", "object play", "play-fight", "total play")

lapply(names(rpt_LPS_prop), function(var) {
  cat("Individual repeatability intra-LPS for", var, "\n")
  print(rpt_LPS_prop[[var]])
})
```

### Pen repeatability

Pen repeatability (i.e., a group of pig) between day 1 and day 2 before LPS.

```{r rpt_LPS_pen,  results="hide"}

  formula <- as.formula(paste("cbind(", var, ",fail_", var, ") ~ (1 | Batch_Pen)", sep = ""))
  
  rptProportion(formula, grname = c("Batch_Pen"), data = data_LPS, nboot = 1000, npermut = 0)

})
```

```{r rpt_LPS_pen_result}

lapply(names(rpt_LPS_prop), function(var) {
```

```{r rpt_Frus_pen_result}
})
```

## Global repeatability (challenge × day)

### Individual repeatability

Repeatability adjusted for challenge, day, and their interaction.

```{r rpt_adjusted_pig,  results="hide"}
data <- RPT_data_WUR

rpt_Global_prop <- lapply(behaviours, function(var) {
  
  formula <- as.formula(paste("cbind(", var, ",fail_", var, ") ~ LPS_Frus*Day + (1 | Pig_ID)", sep = ""))
  
  rptProportion(formula, grname = c("Pig_ID"), data = data, nboot = 1000, npermut = 0)

})
```

```{r rpt_adjusted_pig_result}
names(rpt_Global_prop) <- c("individual locomotor play", "social locomotor play", "object play", "play-fight", "total play")
```

```{r rpt_adjusted_pen_result}
})
```

# Correlation analyses

## WUR

### LPS challenge

#### Variable selection

```{r variables_LPS}
WUR_LPS <- read.csv("../data/WUR_LPS.csv", sep=";")

data <- WUR_LPS
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Pig_ID = as.factor(Pig_ID),
    Batch = as.factor(Batch),
    Pen = as.factor(Pen)
  )

# Define variables
behavior_vars <- c("p_total_play",	"p_object_play",	"p_locomotor_individual",	"p_locomotor_social",	"p_play_fight")
physio_vars <- c("Cortisol_Baseline", "Glucose_Baseline", "Lactate_Baseline", "Temperature_Baseline", "dROM_Baseline",   "Cortisol_Amplitude", "Glucose_Amplitude", "Lactate_Amplitude", "Temperature_Amplitude", "dROM_Amplitude", "ADG_38_45", "ADG_45_52")
```

**Metadata**:\
- *Pig_ID*: individual identification number of a pig.\
- *Batch*: batches included in this dataset ["3", "4", "5", "6"].\
- *Pen*: identification number for each pen ["2", "3", "8", "9"].

**Variables**:\
- *p_indplay, p_socplay, p_playfight, p_objplay, p_totalplay*: proportion of time performing the play type\
- *Cortisol*: plasma cortisol\
- *Glucose*: plasma glucose\
- *Lactate*: plasma D-lactate\
- *Temperature*: rectal temperature\
- *dROM*: derivatives of reactive oxygen metabolites\
- *ADG_38_45*: Average daily gain calculated between 38 and 45 days of age (before the LPS challenge)\
- *ADG_45_52*: Average daily gain calculated between 45 and 52 days of age (after the LPS challenge)\
- **Baseline** variables were measured just before the LPS challenge\
- **Amplitude** variables were calculated over the measurements at 1 hour, 3 hours and 5 hours after the challenge.

#### Extract residuals

```{r model_residuals_LPS}
residuals_dataset <- data.frame(Pig_ID = data$Pig_ID)

for (var in c(behavior_vars, physio_vars)) {
  #arcsine transformation for proportions of play, raw data for physiology
  x <- if (var %in% behavior_vars) asin(sqrt(data[[var]])) else data[[var]] 
  residuals_dataset[[var]] <- residuals(
    lmer(x ~ 1 + (1 | Batch), data = data, na.action = na.exclude)
  )
}
```

#### Correlations play-physio

```{r Spearman_LPS}
results_df_LPS <- bind_rows(lapply(behavior_vars, function(b) {
  lapply(physio_vars, function(p) {
    
    test <- cor.test(
      residuals_dataset[[b]],
      residuals_dataset[[p]],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    
    data.frame(
      behavior = b,
      physiology = p,
      correlation = unname(test$estimate),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
    
  }) |> bind_rows()
})) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

heatmap_df <- results_df_LPS %>%
  mutate(
    sig = p_value < 0.05,
    physiology = factor(
      physiology,
      levels = c(
        unique(physiology[grepl("Amplitude", physiology)]),
        unique(physiology[grepl("Baseline", physiology)]),
        unique(physiology[grepl("ADG", physiology)])
      )
    )
  )

heatmap_LPS <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(y = physiology, x = behavior, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(correlation, 2),
        fontface = ifelse(sig, "bold", "plain"))
    ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
        title = "LPS challenge",
    x = "Play behaviour",
    y = "Physiological variable",
    fill = "Spearman r"
  )  +
theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 90, hjust = 1),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5)
)

heatmap_LPS

ggsave(
  "../plots/Fig3-1_heatmap_LPS.png",
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 500
)
```

#### Visualisation

```{r visualisation_LPS}
# Filter significant results
sig_LPS <- results_df_LPS %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05)

#Function for scatter plot
plot_corr <- function(data, xvar, yvar, r = NA, p = NA) {
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste(xvar, "vs", yvar),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "method = ", sig_LPS$method[i],
        " | r = ", signif(r, 3),
        " | p = ", signif(p, 3)
        )
      )
}

plots_LPS <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(sig_LPS)) {
  
  x <- sig_LPS$behavior[i]
  y <- sig_LPS$physiology[i]
  
  plots_LPS[[i]] <- plot_corr(
    residuals_dataset,
    xvar = x,
    yvar = y,
    r = sig_LPS$correlation[i],
    p = sig_LPS$p_value[i]
  )
}

for(p in plots_LPS) {
  print(p)
}
```

#### Correlation within play

```{r Spearman_LPS_play}
results_df_LPS_play <- bind_rows(lapply(behavior_vars, function(b) {
  lapply(behavior_vars, function(p) {
    
    test <- cor.test(
      residuals_dataset[[b]],
      residuals_dataset[[p]],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    
    data.frame(
      behavior1 = b,
      behavior2 = p,
      correlation = unname(test$estimate),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
    
  })}) |> bind_rows()
) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

heatmap_df <- results_df_LPS_play %>%
  mutate(
    sig = p_value < 0.05
    )

heatmap_LPS_play <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(y = behavior1, x = behavior2, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(correlation, 2),
        fontface = ifelse(sig, "bold", "plain"))
    ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
        title = "LPS challenge",
    x = "Play behaviour",
    y = "Play behaviour",
    fill = "Spearman r"
  )  +
theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 90, hjust = 1),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5)
)

heatmap_LPS_play

)
```

```{r variables_Frus}
physio_vars <- c("Cortisol_Baseline", "Glucose_Baseline", "Lactate_Baseline", "dROM_Baseline",   "Cortisol_Amplitude", "Glucose_Amplitude", "Lactate_Amplitude", "dROM_Amplitude", "ADG_45_52")
```

## ANSES

### Play histograms

```{r graphs_ETEC}
ANSES <- read.csv("../data/ANSES.csv", sep=";") 

# Define variables
behavior_vars <- c("p_total_play",	"p_enrichment",	"p_locomotor_individual",	"p_locomotor_social",	"p_play_fight")
physio_vars <- c("cortisol_Baseline", "Glucose_Baseline", "Lactate_Baseline", "Temperature_Baseline", "DROM_Baseline", "FRAP_Baseline", "NEFA_Baseline",  "Granulo_lymphocyte_ratio_Baseline",	"Haptoglobin_Baseline",	"NB_monocyte_Baseline","cortisol_Amplitude", "Glucose_Amplitude", "Lactate_Amplitude", "Temperature_Amplitude", "DROM_Amplitude", "FRAP_Amplitude", "NEFA_Amplitude",  "Granulo_lymphocyte_ratio_Amplitude",	"Haptoglobin_Amplitude",	"NB_monocyte_Amplitude","ADG_baseline", "ADG_D0_D9")	

play_by_pig <- ANSES %>%
    group_by(Pig_ID, Inoculation, Housing) %>%
    summarise(
        played = any(p_total_play-p_enrichment > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

# Proportions de porcs ayant joué ou non
summary_play <- play_by_pig %>%
    group_by(Inoculation, Housing) %>%
    summarise(
        n_pigs = n(),
        n_played = sum(played),
        n_never_played = sum(!played),
        prop_played = n_played / n_pigs,
        prop_never_played = n_never_played / n_pigs,
        .groups = "drop"
    )

summary_play

data <- ANSES %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(p_enrichment, p_locomotor_individual, p_locomotor_social, p_play_fight),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Proportion"
  )

data <- data %>%
  group_by(Housing, Inoculation, Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    SEM = sd(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE) /
          sqrt(sum(!is.na(Proportion))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ETEC_play <- ggplot(data,
             aes(x = Variable, y = mean, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - SEM,
        ymax = mean + SEM),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(Housing ~ Inoculation) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange", "pink", "violet", "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "ETEC challenge",
    x = "Play behaviour",
    y = "Proportion of time",
    fill = "Variable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ETEC_play

ggsave(
  "../plots/Fig2_Play_proportion_before_ETEC.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 500
)
```

### ETEC challenge

#### Variable selection

```{r variables_inoc}
data <- ANSES[which(ANSES$Inoculation == "inoc"),]
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Pig_ID = as.factor(Pig_ID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex), 
    Batch = as.factor(Batch), 
    Housing = as.factor(Housing), 
    Inoculation = as.factor(Inoculation), 
    Pen_ID  = as.factor(Pen_ID)
  )
```

**Metadata**:\
- *Pig_ID*: individual identification number of a pig.\
- *Batch*: batches included in this dataset ["1", "3"].\
- *Pen_ID*: identification number for each pen ["B1", "B2", "E3", "E4"].\
- *Sex*: sex of the pig as male ["M"] or female ["F"].\
- *Housing*: housing condition of the pig either enriched ["ENR"] or barren ["MIN"].\
- *Inoculation*: inoculation status of the pig either control inoculated with sterile broth ["control"] or ETEC ["inoc"].

**Variables**:\
- *p_totalplay, p_locomotor_play_solitary, p_locomotor_play_group, p_play_fight, p_enrichment*: proportion of time performing the play type\
- *Cortisol*: plasma cortisol\
- *Glucose*: plasma glucose\
- *Lactate*: plasma D-lactate\
- *Temperature*: rectal temperature\
- *dROM*: plasma derivatives of reactive oxygen metabolites\
- *FRAP*: ferric reducing ability of plasma\
- *NEFA*: plamsa non-esterified fatty acids\
- *Granulo_lymphocyte_ratio*: plasma granulocytes to lymphocytes ratio\
- *NB_monocyte*: plasma monocytes\
- *Haptoglobin*: plasma haptoglobin\
- **Baseline** variables were measured three days before inoculation\
- **Amplitude** variables were calculated over the measurements between D1 and D3 post-challenge\
- *ADG_baseline*: Average daily gain calculated between between the day before weaning and day 11 post-weaning (inoculation)\
- *ADG_D0_D9*: Average daily gain calculated between D0 (inoculation) and D9 post-inoculation.

#### Extract residuals

```{r model_residuals_inoc}
residuals_dataset <- data.frame(Pig_ID = data$Pig_ID)

for (var in c(behavior_vars, physio_vars)) {
  #arcsine transformation for proportions of play, raw data for physiology
  x <- if (var %in% behavior_vars) asin(sqrt(data[[var]])) else data[[var]] 
  residuals_dataset[[var]] <- residuals(
    lmer(x ~ Sex + Housing + (1 | Batch), data = data, na.action = na.exclude)
  )
}
```

#### Correlations play-physio

```{r Spearman_inoc}
results_df_inoc <- bind_rows(lapply(behavior_vars, function(b) {
  lapply(physio_vars, function(p) {
    
    test <- cor.test(
      residuals_dataset[[b]],
      residuals_dataset[[p]],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    
    data.frame(
      behavior = b,
      physiology = p,
      correlation = unname(test$estimate),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
    
  }) |> bind_rows()
})) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))

heatmap_df <- results_df_inoc %>%
  mutate(
    sig = p_value < 0.05,
    physiology = factor(
      physiology,
      levels = c(
        unique(physiology[grepl("Amplitude", physiology)]),
        unique(physiology[grepl("Baseline", physiology)]),
        unique(physiology[grepl("ADG", physiology)])
      )
    )
  )

heatmap_ETEC <- ggplot(heatmap_df, aes(y = physiology, x = behavior, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(correlation, 2),
        fontface = ifelse(sig, "bold", "plain"))
    ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
            title = "ETEC challenge",
    x = "Play behaviour",
    y = "Physiological variable",
    fill = "Spearman r"
  )  +
theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 90, hjust = 1),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5)
)

heatmap_ETEC

ggsave(
  "../plots/Fig4-1_heatmap_ETEC.png",
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 500
)
```

#### Visualisation

```{r visualisation_inoc}
# Filter significant results
sig_inoc <- results_df_inoc %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05)

#Function for scatter plot
plot_corr <- function(data, xvar, yvar, r = NA, p = NA) {
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[xvar]], y = .data[[yvar]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste(xvar, "vs", yvar),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "method = ", sig_inoc$method[i],
        " | r = ", signif(r, 3),
        " | p = ", signif(p, 3)
        )
      )
}

plots_inoc <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(sig_inoc)) {
  
  x <- sig_inoc$behavior[i]
  y <- sig_inoc$physiology[i]
  
  plots_inoc[[i]] <- plot_corr(
    residuals_dataset,
    xvar = x,
    yvar = y,
    r = sig_inoc$correlation[i],
    p = sig_inoc$p_value[i]
  )
}

for(p in plots_inoc) {
  print(p)
}
```
